# Cozy Cafe UI Kit runtime subset

This folder contains a deliberately limited runtime subset of **Cozy Cafe UI
Kit Premium v3.0.9 — Warm Palette QA Reviewed** by Nexa Visuals.

The game uses the textless 1x button states and a small group of scalable panel
assets. Labels, icons, focus behavior, and localization remain native Godot
controls. The full purchased source pack is intentionally not redistributed in
this repository.

See `LICENSE.txt` for the vendor's commercial-use terms.
